concerns.text: SC‑006 specifies that collinearity must be flagged when r² > 0.8, but task T008’s verification flags VIF > 5 or |r| > 0.8. The metric does not match the specification, so the requirement is not satisfied.
Task T015 is a threshold‑sensitivity sweep (FR‑005) but is incorrectly tagged with `[FR-004]`. The tag should reference FR‑005 to reflect its purpose.
